author: Ghost Developer Studio
description: Build one goal at a time on {{project}}: slice the context for {{goal}}, build it, audit it, improve it twice, verify it, and only then move to the next goal. This is the loop used for the GhostSlice 20 goal marathon.

inputs.description: Path to the project being built.
inputs.name: project

inputs.description: One goal, stated in one sentence.
inputs.name: goal

name: Slice Marathon Loop
notes: No publish, no announcement, and no paid spend without a separate approval. A push is not a release.

steps.detail: Write {{goal}} in one sentence, with the test that proves it is done.
steps.title: Define one goal

steps.detail: Use GhostSlice to export the smallest context bundle that covers the goal. Record the token estimate before and after slicing. Token counts are estimates, not exact counts.
steps.gate: Bundle exists and its manifest totals are recorded.
steps.title: Slice the context

steps.detail: Build only what the goal names. Do not add features from later goals.
steps.title: Build the goal

steps.detail: Run the full test suite. Look for gaps, edge cases, and anything the build claimed but did not prove.
steps.title: Audit, first pass

steps.detail: Fix the most important audit finding and re-run the tests.
steps.title: Improve once

steps.detail: Make a second, separate improvement. Do not repeat the first one and call it the second.
steps.title: Improve twice

steps.detail: Confirm the pass condition from the first step is met with evidence, not by claim.
steps.gate: Do not move to the next goal until this goal is verified.
steps.title: Verify before moving on

steps.detail: Push the verified work to the project repo. A push is not a release: it carries no tag, no publish, and no announcement.
steps.title: Push the verified goal

steps.detail: A release, a package publish, and any announcement are separate approvals, each decided on its own. None of them is bundled into the push step or into this recipe.
steps.gate: Separate approval for any release, publish, or announcement.
steps.title: Release only with separate approval
